Holder sync uint32 is at+0,collision id+4. Iterate holder order; missing id skipped. Compare actor position to collision previous position, set/clear collision flag6 and write current position.
warpProc true returns; bit19 invokes jump; then bit18 bypasses CheckOutMap, otherwise true sets actor bit13. Jump callback changes are visible before next gate.

Idle warp branch requires both WarpPos abs components<4, clears Actor bit25, returns false; active request explicitly refused.
